summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Agriculture to support nurseries and seed orchards through partnerships, technical assistance, and a new grant program for expanding production capacity, improving infrastructure, and promoting workforce development in reforestation supply chains.

scores.thoughts: The bill establishes a grant program and authorizes the Secretary of Agriculture to obligate up to $5,000,000 annually from the Reforestation Trust Fund to support nurseries and seed orchards. This directly involves government expenditure.
